title: Mixed Event — STRAY BAD DOG — Episode3 Collision

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD shows signs of growth, inspired by changes in Toya. One day, they'll be able to reach the heights of that legendary night. With that thought in his head, Akito learns of the man said to be the closest to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Line: Outside the Vivid Street live house

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Hey, are you free after this? A few of my musician friends are getting together, so wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I have a date with a chocolate parfait after this show! I sort of can't miss it!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Apologies, but I'll be... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry to interrupt you, but are you Arata Tono?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I perform around here and have been hearing a lot of rumors about someone named Tono...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, would you mind if we could have a little chat?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, is that Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You're right, it's him!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? I feel like I've seen you before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm Akito Shinonome.
I sing for Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, Vivid BAD SQUAD!
I've been to one of your events!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And you're his teammate too, no? Nice to meet you, I'm Arata Tono.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It's nice to meet you.
My name is Toya Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're partners on the same team.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Partners, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
I see.
Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What was that? Something's changed all of a sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Would you mind us asking a quick question, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Of course, if it's something I can answer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then... Is it true that your dream is to surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Well, to put it into better perspective...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I don't want to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I will surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tono, were you actually at RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
My best friend was really into music and dragged me along to go see it.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We sort of got caught up in the moment and decided that we'd put on an even bigger event together.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So in a way, it's not my dream to surpass RAD WEEKEND, rather my friend's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we heard that you've been participating in events on your own...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, I have.
Well, things happened.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Now, I'm working to surpass it all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Surpass RAD WEEKEND on your own...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're being serious?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you were actually there, you'd know that it's not realistic for just one person to do that on their own...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, I'm more than aware of that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I believe that I am more capable of doing that than you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You also wish to surpass RAD WEEKEND too, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you knew...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, I did. I started hearing rumors just after I came back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That Vivid BAD SQUAD wants to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But you've honestly been a disappointment...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was hoping for more since Ken spoke so highly of your team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What exactly do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
My, what a scary face.
Excuse that last comment.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: However, my declaration still stands. You do not have what it takes to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: With time, I'm sure you'll go somewhere, but I'll have long since succeeded by then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still haven't seen you perform, but I wouldn't get so cocky now either.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, it's nothing like that.
I'm just speaking my mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: It still hasn't gotten through to you yet, so let me explain it in simpler terms...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Aoyagi, was it?
You seem to have quite an ear and perfect pitch to match. Your incredible talents are going to waste.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And that An girl has been doing well for herself too. Ken's daughter should be able to do as much, but she still needs more polishing...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And that other girl, I forget her name... She has some manner of singing talent, but still too amateurish during live performances.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I would never have let her join in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You...!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And above all else...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've heard enough...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All this talk means you have to be that much better than us, right?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, naturally.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then let's find out who's actually better.
You or us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we can get this crowd more pumped up than you, you'll take back what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, does this mean Arata and Vivid BAD SQUAD are gonna duke it out...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: No way! That would be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
So it's a battle you want?
Fine. Everybody here seems to be itching to see one too.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hey, you there.
Mind if we borrow some of your equipment?

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: Go for it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You can sing, right?
You sounded fine just now, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure you want to do this? What good can actually come out of this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then what do you suggest we do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't just let him rag on us like that...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, you don't have to do it, because I will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'll sing too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm your partner. You're not doing this alone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's keep this simple. You can choose any song you like and the one that gets the crowd more pumped up is the winner.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Fine, so be it.
Who goes first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We are.
We're gonna end things before you even get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. Your confidence is commendable. But you'll need more than that to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know.
That's all we've been working towards this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not doing this for fun.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Not doing this for fun, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Everything's all set!
So, who's going first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: FYI, we're not holding back.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Be my guest. Give it everything you have.
song00008_off_s

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...! Right out of the gates!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, and this is the first BAD DOGS performance in a while too! This is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, not bad...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But it's not enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How's that?
You still think you can win?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, of course.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Now, if you'll allow me...
